title: The punctured-line inclusion is over the base field
statement: For every field $k$, the polynomial-to-Laurent inclusion $j:C_{true}\to C_{false}$ and structure maps of [def-pur-kummer-line-geometry] satisfy $j\mathbin{;}a_{false}=a_{true}$.

source.place: Step 2: canonical module-valued strict-local comparison, constants, Kummer generators and restriction.

proof.text: Unpack [def-pur-kummer-line-geometry]: put $u:k[t]\to k[t,t^{-1}]$ for the polynomial-to-Laurent inclusion, and $c_P:k\to k[t]$, $c_L:k\to k[t,t^{-1}]$ for the constant maps. By [def-weil-polynomial-ring] and [def-weil-laurent-polynomial-ring], $c_P(a)$ has coefficient $a$ in exponent $0$ and zero elsewhere; the inclusion $u$ keeps the coefficients in nonnegative exponents and assigns zero to negative exponents. Thus $u(c_P(a))=c_L(a)$ for every $a\in k$, including $a=0$. Equality of ring homomorphisms is equality on every element, so $u\circ c_P=c_L$.

source.place: Step 2, final paragraph: the factorization π = pj and restriction along j; coordinate models in def-pur-kummer-line-geometry.

proof.text: By [def-pur-kummer-line-geometry], $j=\operatorname{Spec}(u)$, $a_{false}=\operatorname{Spec}(c_P)$ and $a_{true}=\operatorname{Spec}(c_L)$. The contravariant functoriality stated in [def-weil-affine-spectrum] gives $j\mathbin{;}a_{false}=\operatorname{Spec}(u\circ c_P)$. Substituting the equality of ring homomorphisms from step 1 gives $\operatorname{Spec}(c_L)=a_{true}$, as required.
